# BCI-01→30 — Blockchain Engineering Professional Pathway (external/market)

## Grounding

Per `CYBERSECURE_BLOCKCHAIN_GALA_HOSPITALITY_LABELOS_RECONCILIATION.md`:
coverage `PARTIAL` against the real legacy formation `BCH-01`
("Blockchain culturelle et tokenisation", `backend/seed_data.py`, 36h,
8 modules, **includes a real testnet smart-contract deployment
deliverable**, M03) — `BCH-01` is an intro survey; BCI-01→30 is the
full professional-depth blockchain-engineering pathway (protocol
engineer, smart-contract security auditor, tokenomics designer, Web3
product manager). Action: `EXTEND_EXISTING`/`SPECIALIZE_EXISTING` on
`BCH-01` — same "specialization path built from a foundation
formation" pattern already used for FMS-08/09 on FMS-03.

`BCH-01` itself stays exactly as delivered (untouched, its own real
runtime formation) — this cluster never rebuilds it, only cites its
real M03 testnet-deployment deliverable as the worked example for the
smart-contract-security modules below (BCI-04, BCI-36-equivalent
content).

## Objectives

Teach the real, professional-depth blockchain-engineering disciplines
this cluster covers, citing `BCH-01`'s real testnet deployment as the
one grounded worked example, never inventing a CVLN-operated
blockchain infrastructure beyond it:

- Protocol/blockchain foundations, consensus, and network architecture.
- Smart-contract development and security auditing (grounded in
  `BCH-01`/M03's real testnet deployment).
- Token standards and cultural-asset tokenization design.
- Tokenomics fundamentals (foundation-level — deepened by `docs/bci/
  external/tok01_15/`, never rebuilt twice).
- Governance mechanisms, legal/compliance for digital assets.
- Web3 product management.

## Modules

1. Blockchain/protocol foundations and consensus mechanisms.
2. Smart-contract development — worked example: `BCH-01`/M03's real
   testnet deployment, cited by reference, never re-derived.
3. Smart-contract security auditing.
4. Token standards and cultural-asset tokenization design.
5. Tokenomics foundations (foundation-level only — see `tok01_15/` for
   the economist-depth track).
6. Governance mechanisms for decentralized systems.
7. Legal/compliance for digital assets (market-general).
8. Web3 product management.
9. Boundary discipline — no CVLN blockchain infrastructure exists
   beyond the pedagogical `BCH-01`/M03 testnet exercise; `BCI-31→40`
   (internal operator layer) is `BLOCKED_PRODUCT_DEPENDENCY`, never
   simulated here.

## Assessment

A discipline-literacy exam graded against real blockchain-engineering
practice, with an eliminatory check on claiming any CVLN-operated
production blockchain infrastructure beyond the one real pedagogical
testnet deployment already delivered in `BCH-01`.
